resources.string: Connect a device to get started.
Bluetooth permission is required to scan and connect to tags.
Tag needs Bluetooth to find nearby BLE devices.\n\nOn Android 11 and below, Location must also be allowed and turned ON for BLE scanning (the app does not track your location).
Turn on Location (required for BLE scan on Android 11).
Scanning all nearby BLE devices…\n\nAny BLE device will appear. Only Tag GATT will connect successfully.
